title: The Hidden Treasure: Stacy's Metal Detecting Adventure
style_guide: Very realistic, low-quality images, mimicking a 360p handheld phone photo style with natural colors, flat lighting, JPEG artifacts, 16:9 aspect ratio.

scenes.narration: Thirteen-year-old Stacy loved metal detecting, a hobby from her grandpa.
scenes.visual: A young girl with a metal detector on a beach, low-res, handheld style, with a simple backpack.
scenes.image_prompt: Realistic low-quality photo of a girl in casual clothes holding a metal detector on a sandy beach, flat lighting, JPEG artifacts.

scenes.narration: One day, the beach was closed due to strong winds, so she went to the nearby forest.
scenes.visual: A forest scene with tall oak trees, a narrow dirt path, and a girl with her metal detector, hand-held phone style.
scenes.image_prompt: Low-res photo of a girl with a metal detector in a forest near large oak trees, flat lighting, JPEG artifacts.

scenes.narration: She found some small metal objects and bullet shells.
scenes.visual: Close-up of small rusted metal items and shells on the forest ground, natural colors, low resolution.
scenes.image_prompt: Realistic photo showing small metal objects and bullet shells on leaf-covered ground, JPEG artifacts.

scenes.narration: Then her detector signaled again, and she uncovered a large silver coin.
scenes.visual: Girl kneeling, holding a shiny silver coin with an engraved crest, dirt and leaves around.
scenes.image_prompt: Low-quality photo of a girl holding a silver coin with an unfamiliar crest, in a forest setting, JPEG artifacts.

scenes.narration: Excited, she took photos and shared her discovery online.
scenes.visual: A phone screen showing a social media post of the coin, with a girl smiling nearby.
scenes.image_prompt: Realistic low-res photo of a smartphone screen displaying a picture of a silver coin, girl looking at it, JPEG artifacts.

scenes.narration: The post quickly went viral, with many comments. One anonymous user offered to buy it.
scenes.visual: A social media comment thread visible on a phone screen, with an anonymous comment highlighted.
scenes.image_prompt: Low-quality photo of social media comments on a phone, showing a suspicious anonymous offer, JPEG artifacts.

scenes.narration: Suddenly, the post disappeared. The next morning, police arrived.
scenes.visual: A shot of a simple house exterior with police cars parked outside, low-res, flat lighting.
scenes.image_prompt: Realistic photo of a suburban house with police cars in front, low quality, JPEG artifacts.

scenes.narration: Officers took Stacy and her mother for questioning about the coin.
scenes.visual: Interior of a small police station, with a girl and her mother sitting at a table talking to officers.
scenes.image_prompt: Low-quality photo of a police station interior, girl and mother talking with officers, JPEG artifacts.

scenes.narration: It turned out the coin was stolen from a private collection.
scenes.visual: An officer showing a report or photo of the coin to Stacy, in a simple room.
scenes.image_prompt: Realistic low-res scene of a police officer handing a paper or photo to a girl, JPEG artifacts.

scenes.narration: Stacy learned an important lesson about responsibility and being cautious online.
scenes.visual: Girl looking thoughtful, with her phone off to the side, in a natural setting, casual clothing.
scenes.image_prompt: Low-res photo of a girl sitting outdoors, reflecting, casual clothes, JPEG artifacts.
